description: Contact details published on one public web page you name (https only): mailto and tel links, email addresses written in the page text, and links to social profiles, plus the page title. Reads the single page only, does not crawl, and returns nothing that the page does not show. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_facebook_page_contact_info when you need Contact details from a Facebook Page's About tab: category; social_instagram_contact when you need Public contact details of an Instagram account. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
